headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: NASA's Hubble Telescope Reaches Milestone, Looks for Elusive Supernova
headlines.summary: An image from NASA's Hubble Space Telescope of galaxy cluster MACS J0417 is part of repeated observations to monitor for the reappearance of supernova Athena, which can help astronomers measure the expansion rate of the universe.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: NASA's Chandra Finds Unusual Objects in Pinwheel Galaxy
headlines.summary: Using NASA’s Chandra X-ray Observatory, scientists have discovered a new class of objects behaving unlike any they have seen before.

headlines.text: NASA Astronaut Reid Wiseman Attends Ravens vs. Saints Game
headlines.summary: NASA astronaut and commander of the agency’s Artemis II mission, Reid Wiseman, a Baltimore native, takes a selfie with fans at an NFL game between the New Orleans Saints and the Baltimore Ravens at M&T Bank Stadium, Sunday, Sept. 20, 2026, in Baltimore.

headlines.text: COSI Telescope Comes Together
headlines.summary: UC Berkeley engineers and managers watch as the COSI (Compton Spectrometer and Imager) detector assembly is slowly raised from a table in this July 8, 2026, image.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: NASA Unveils Enterprise, the First Space Shuttle
headlines.summary: The rollout ceremony for NASA’s first space shuttle, OV-101, coincided with Constitution Day of the nation’s bicentennial on Sept.17, 1976. Although the orbiter was originally planned to be named Constitution, Star Trek fans successfully convinced President Gerald Ford to name it Enterprise after the series’ fictional starship.

headlines.summary: Anak Krakatau erupts ash and volcanic gases in this image acquired with the OLI (Operational Land Imager) on Landsat 8 on Sept. 5, 2026.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: NASA's Chandra Spots Galactic Gem
headlines.summary: Galaxies are like cosmic gems, each with characteristics including size and shape that make them distinct. A gallery from NASA’s Chandra X-ray Observatory and other telescopes displays a collection of galactic images that showcase this variety.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: Dust and Water in Sagittarius A*
headlines.summary: Using the James Webb Space Telescope, an international team of astronomers have discovered that dust and water can form and survive surprisingly close to the supermassive black hole at the center of our Milky Way galaxy.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: Artemis II Crew at NASA Marshall
headlines.summary: The crew of NASA’s Artemis II mission visited NASA’s Marshall Space Flight Center in Huntsville, Alabama on Sept. 1, 2026.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: Superbubble in the Large Magellanic Cloud
headlines.summary: N44 is a complex nebula filled with glowing hydrogen gas, dark lanes of dust, massive stars, and many populations of stars of different ages. One of its most distinctive features, however, is the dark, starry gap called a “superbubble,” visible in this Hubble Space Telescope image in the upper central region.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: Lunar Occultation of Venus
headlines.summary: On Wednesday, June 17, skywatchers across the United States—and parts of Canada—enjoyed a rare event: a daytime lunar occultation of Venus. A lunar occultation occurs when the Moon moves directly in front of another celestial object from our viewpoint on Earth, briefly hiding it from sight.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: Igniting Roman's Journey
headlines.summary: Now on a three-month, million-mile journey to its final orbit, NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope will soon reveal the universe’s darkest secrets. The mission launched at 7:26 a.m. EDT on Aug. 30 aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket from Launch Complex 39A at the agency’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: August Lunar Eclipse Rises Over Louisiana
headlines.summary: A lunar eclipse is visible over southern Louisiana. The lunar eclipse was visible throughout much of North and South America and part of Europe and Africa between Aug. 27-28. The Full Moon slipped through Earth’s shadow on Aug. 27, continuing into Aug. 28 for some parts of the world, resulting in the lunar eclipse. headlines.summary: President Donald J. Trump awarded NASA astronauts Victor Glover and Christina Koch, CSA (Canadian Space Agency) astronaut Jeremy Hansen, and NASA astronaut Reid Wiseman with the Congressional Space Medal of Honor on Aug. 28, 2026, at NASA’s Johnson Space Center in Houston.

headlines.summary: From left, Expedition 75 flight engineers Anil Menon of NASA (partially obscured and wearing the spacesuit with a red stripe on the legs) and Sophie Adenot of ESA (European Space Agency) work together during a six‑hour and 23‑minute spacewalk outside the International Space Station.

Photo Credit: (NASA/Joel Kowsky)

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: Webb Opens Treasure Chest
headlines.summary: This NASA/ESA/CSA James Webb Space Telescope Picture of the Month takes us to a fantastical realm within our home galaxy, where piercing starlight and billowing winds sculpt dust clouds into inventive shapes. This scene is from the Carina Nebula, which lies just 7500 light-years away in the constellation Carina (the Keel).

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: Artemis Mission Patches
headlines.summary: A NASA jacket containing Artemis I and II mission patches, along with other NASA patches hangs on the back of a chair on Thursday, Aug. 6, 2026, inside Firing Room 1 of the Rocco A. Petrone Launch Control Center at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida during a terminal countdown simulation for the Artemis III mission.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: Ancient Milky Way Merger
headlines.summary: About 12 billion years ago, a dwarf galaxy known as LKH collided with a young Milky Way and merged with it. This artist’s concept portrays that collision. NASA’s Hubble Space Telescope uncovered definitive evidence of this collision by studying globular star clusters.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: NASA's B777 Gets New Coat of Paint
headlines.summary: NASA's Boeing 777 returns to the agency's Langley Research Center after receiving a new paint scheme.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: Colorful Collage of Tarantula Nebula
headlines.summary: Like a collage made of layered sheets of colored cellophane, a vibrant new image layers observations of a famous star-forming nebula from NASA space telescopes. The resulting cosmic “craft” reveals new details about the star formation region known as 30 Doradus, or the Tarantula Nebula.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: Total Solar Eclipse in Sunflower Field
headlines.summary: This composite image shows the progression of a total solar eclipse over San Millán de los Caballeros, Spain on, Wednesday, Aug. 12, 2026.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: Perseids Meteor Shower
headlines.summary: The constellation Orion is framed by two Perseid meteors on Aug. 12, 2018, in Cedar Breaks National Monument, Utah.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: 2026 Total Solar Eclipse in Spain
headlines.summary: A total solar eclipse is seen from San Millán de los Caballeros, Spain, Wednesday, Aug. 12, 2026.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: Lion Nebula Roars in Webb's Sights
headlines.summary: NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope imaged the planetary nebula NGC 2392, the Lion Nebula, using the observatory’s NIRCam and MIRI instruments. The central star’s remains are responsible for the nebula’s structure, including a lion face-shaped bubble of ionized gas and dust “mane.”

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: NASA Astronaut Jessica Meir Uses VR Goggles
headlines.summary: NASA astronaut and Expedition 75 commander Jessica Meir wears a set of virtual reality goggles, also called the Nevada Screening Vision System, for a test that measures visual function using a series of vision screening apps testing visual acuity, contrast sensitivity, and more.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: NASA's IXPE Studies Magnetar
headlines.summary: A first of its kind measurement of a magnetar may have captured empty space behaving in a way physicists have predicted for 90 years, but never directly observed. The results published Wednesday in Nature.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: Taking Flight to Prepare for Space
headlines.summary: NASA astronaut candidate Adam Fuhrmann prepares for a training flight aboard NASA’s WB-57 aircraft.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: Artemis III Orion Crew and Service Modules Joined
headlines.summary: Engineers connect the Orion crew and service modules for the Artemis III mission inside the Neil A. Armstrong Operations and Checkout Building at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: Roman Space Telescope Plaque Install
headlines.summary: Technicians inside the Payload Hazardous Servicing Facility at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center complete installation of a commemorative plaque on the agency’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, as photographed on Tuesday, July 28, 2026.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: Guinea-Bissau Tidal Waters
headlines.summary: Relatively low tidal waters expose sandflats and mudflats in the Bijagós Archipelago of Guinea-Bissau in this image acquired on November 28, 2025, with the OLI (Operational Land Imager) on Landsat 8. These coastal landforms support an array of invertebrates, making the archipelago a popular stopover for migratory shorebirds.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: NASA's Newest Wind Tunnel Opens at NASA Langley
headlines.summary: NASA opened its newest wind tunnel, the Flight Dynamics Research Facility at NASA’s Langley Research Center in Hampton, Virginia, on Friday, providing a critical resource for the agency and its partners to test the safety and performance of future generations of aircraft, rockets, and space exploration vehicles.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: Starburst Galaxy Centaurus A
headlines.summary: NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope’s Mid-Infrared Instrument (MIRI) reveals the nearby galaxy Centaurus A, exposing the dusty structures and hidden activity that shape this unusual system.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: Understanding How Martian Auroras Are Made
headlines.summary: This illustration depicts charged particles from a solar storm stripping away charged particles of Mars' atmosphere, one of the processes of Martian atmosphere loss studied by NASA's MAVEN mission.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: NASA Astronaut Chris Williams Returns to Earth
headlines.summary: NASA astronaut Chris Williams is seen outside the Soyuz MS-28 spacecraft after he landed with Expedition 74 Roscosmos cosmonauts Sergey Kud-Sverchkov, and Sergei Mikaev in a remote area near the town of Zhezkazgan, Kazakhstan on Sunday, July 26, 2026. The trio returned to Earth after logging 241 days in space as a members of Expeditions 73 and 74 aboard the International Space Station.

headlines.label: NASA image of the day
headlines.text: New Crew Members Welcomed to International Space Station
headlines.summary: From left, Expedition 74 flight engineers Anna Kikina and Pyotr Dubrov of Roscosmos, and Anil Menon of NASA pose for a portrait while holding a cake celebrating their recent arrival aboard the International Space Station.
